submitter: vigilant_designer_offer_analysis lane — owner Decision D, authorised directly 2026-09-02; migration 723
rationale:
The owner rejected a hero reading 'No vendor pays us, so the choice is made on fit alone' — true, strongly stated, and in his words probably far down the visitor's list. His model of the visitor, verbatim in substance: 'the first feeling or doubt in their mind is what this tool as a whole is going to get them and how much work it's going to be to get it done… the independence of the data may be quite far down their list.'

That critique is STRUCTURAL, not a specimen defect, and this lane measured why. [MEASURED 2026-08-31, n=186 across 32 sites] the share of `lead_with` points marked `differentiated` by rank runs 100/100/97/61/31/30 — monotonic. The ordering key is DIFFERENTIATION, i.e. 'what can we say that competitors cannot', which is a SELLER'S question. The owner's is a buyer's question. So the point ranked where it did BECAUSE it is highly differentiated: the artefact working exactly as built, on the wrong axis for a hero.

⚠ AND THE GAP IS ABSENCE, NOT ORDER — which is why this is a new derivation rather than a re-rank, and it is the measurement that came out AGAINST this lane's own first hypothesis. I expected to show that independence claims outrank effort claims, which would have made this a cheap re-ranking of existing rows. They do not: effort points 19 at mean rank 2.84, independence 10 at 3.00, both better than the 3.51 average — on those n, with regex proxies, that is noise. There is no measured inversion. What is true is that only 19 of 186 points (10%) address effort or practicality AT ALL. Re-ranking cannot surface material that was never derived, and a prompt migration that merely re-sorted would produce the same seller-axis list backwards.

⚠ THE JOIN IS THE DELIVERABLE, NOT THE LIST, and this lane has the evidence for why. `offer_ordering` is is_current on 32 sites with 187 provenance-stamped points, and [MEASURED 2026-09-02] of the five agents that would need it — page-content-writer, build-site-planner, site-planner, content-gap-planner, page-build-handler — NONE reads it. A hierarchy without `answered_by` would be the THIRD provenance-stamped artefact nobody reads. The join turns 'we think they ask X first' into a checkable claim about a specific hero.

plan.summary: Migration 723 (config only, live on apply, no Go): add `question_hierarchy` to offer-analyser's ordering contract — the visitor's likely doubts, ranked, each joined to the lead_with point that answers it or explicitly marked unanswered — and route the new collection through a SECOND invocation of the existing register gate before the write.
plan.risks:
THE PRIMARY RISK IS THAT NEWLY DERIVED MODEL TEXT BYPASSES THE REGISTER GATE, and it is the one this plan is shaped around. [MEASURED 2026-08-31] the producer minted 799 lead_with points in six days with 184 (23%) BORN carrying banned constructions, while migration 667 washed 41 points behind it — and three of that wash landed in a row the producer superseded 55 seconds later, so the migration passed every guard, printed success, stamped the ledger, and changed nothing live. `question_hierarchy` is exactly the same kind of text. A hierarchy written around the gate rebuilds the 23% defect one field along. The gate takes ONE items_key per invocation, so this chains a SECOND invocation rather than changing Go — and the verify block asserts the chain end-to-end, because a gate that runs and whose output is then discarded is the same false green in a new place.

SECOND — THE DEEP-MERGE TRAP, which the existing prompt already warns about and which this key inherits. `ordering` is merged over whatever the site holds, so a key the model omits silently leaves the previous run's value standing and looking current (the bugs_open/327 class). The contract therefore requires the key on every run, and the verify block asserts that the required-every-run warning is still present rather than assuming it.

THIRD — a step without an ai_service block is live, fires, and repairs NOTHING while recording why. offer-analyser has no ROOT ai_service; that failure happened for real in the two-minute window between migrations 681 and 682, and the council's llm_reliability seat predicted it verbatim. The new step copies the sibling's block and the verify asserts it resolves.

PRE-REGISTERED ACCEPTANCE CRITERION, stated so a later reader cannot mistake it for failure: the first pass should come back MOSTLY `unanswered` AT THE TOP. That is the 10%-of-186 measurement restated per site. A first pass that answers everything means the model stretched points to cover questions, which is the failure mode this criterion exists to catch.

BOUNDARY, agreed identically with copy_quality_two_stage: the hierarchy is UNSERVED RATIONALE, structured input only. Modelling it to ORDER content is licensed (owner ruling 12, and he does it himself in the instruction); ASSERTING it in served copy is presumption and stays banned. ⚠ It must never be rendered into a prompt as prose — 'most visitors first ask X' in a writer's context window IS the presumption shape and will be copied verbatim.

SEQUENCING, and it is deliberate: this lands BEFORE any change to the differentiation axis. The axis is confirmed inverted (buyer-relevance governs, differentiation demotes to an input), but re-ranking first would produce the same list backwards for the reason in the rationale.

NOT A RISK BUT READ AS ONE IF ADOPTION IS ZERO: offer_ordering is written only when offer-analyser runs, so an empty census means no site has been re-analysed since apply, NOT that the model ignored the contract. The post-apply block carries the demand-side query.
grounded_in: MEASURED 2026-08-31 live, n=186 ranked lead_with points across 32 sites: share marked `differentiated` by rank = 100/100/97/61/31/30, monotonic. The ordering key is differentiation.

MEASURED 2026-08-31: only 19 of 186 points (10%) match an effort/practicality proxy. Effort points mean rank 2.84 (n=19), independence 10 at 3.00, all-points average 3.51 — no measured inversion, so the gap is absence rather than order. ⚠ A later re-measure read 30% and is NOT comparable: the regex was widened. A different instrument is not a different result.

MEASURED 2026-09-02: of page-content-writer, build-site-planner, site-planner, content-gap-planner and page-build-handler, NONE names offer_ordering or satisfaction_condition in its config. The only live consumers are the producer (domain-strategist) and offer-analyser itself.

MEASURED 2026-08-31 to 09-02: the producer minted 799 lead_with points in six days, 184 (23%) born carrying banned constructions; x_not_y 81, rather_than 53, plainly 29, honest 24, not_just 20, negative_reveal 10. Today's rate at the time was 29%, indistinguishable from the historical rate.

VERIFIED 2026-09-02 at the live agent_definitions row: the chain is verify_ordering_cardinals -> repair_ordering_register (object_field ordering_checked.object, items_key lead_with, text_key point, output ordering_register_checked) -> write_offer_ordering (spec_data ordering_register_checked.object). The gate reads ONE items_key per invocation (repair_ordering_register_action.go:200-238), which is why a second step is the reuse path rather than a Go change.

READ 2026-09-02: the existing prompt already states 'EVERY key shown in "ordering" must be present on every run, including empty arrays and false. That object is merged over whatever this site's ordering already holds, so a key you omit silently leaves the previous run's value standing and looking current.' The new key inherits that contract and the verify asserts the warning survives.

INDUCED 2026-09-02 against the live DB with COMMIT swapped for ROLLBACK: the clean run prints '723 OK: question_hierarchy in the contract at spec_version 2, gated by a second repair_ordering_register invocation, chained into the write'. edits.rationale: The guidance and the output contract. Questions in the visitor's own terms as doubts rather than topics; rank 1 is the FIRST doubt, not the one most important to us, with the explicit note that what we are proudest of usually sits lower and that putting it there is the point. Each question grounded in a named strategy field via from_field, with an instruction not to invent one that cannot be grounded. spec_version 1 -> 2.

edits.rationale: The second gate invocation — the reuse that keeps newly derived text inside the same register discipline as lead_with, without a Go change. Its ai_service block is copied from the sibling step deliberately, because offer-analyser has no ROOT ai_service and a step without one is live, firing, and repairing nothing while recording why.

The chain, and the reason the verify block asserts it end to end: a gate that runs and whose output is then discarded is indistinguishable from a gate that worked, which is the false-green shape this lane spent two days on last week.

Asserts exactly one active offer-analyser row FIRST (an agent-config migration keyed on type can hit two active rows; four types carry duplicates today), then the guidance landed, the key is in the contract, spec_version is 2, the required-every-run warning survives, the gate step has a resolvable ai_service, and the chain reaches the write.

Removes the step, restores the chain and strips the contract. Carries the warning a rollback cannot honour: any site re-analysed while 723 was live keeps a question_hierarchy key in its CURRENT row, and because ordering is deep-merged a later run that omits the key leaves the stored one standing and looking current — so the rollback ships the census query to find them and says to strip the key explicitly if that is what is meant.
